title: Lohagad Fort murder: Accused Siya Goyal, Chetan Chaudhary remanded to seven-day police custody
description: A magistrate court near Pune on Tuesday remanded Siya Goyal, who stands accused of murdering her fiancée 26-year-old Ketan Agarwal, to seven days of police custody along with her alleged partner, Chetan Chaudhary.The judicial magistrate at Wadgaon Mawal region near Pune passed the remand order on June 23 after the local police produced Goyal and Chaudhary seeking their custody for further investigation. The case concerns the death of Ketan Agarwal near the Lohagad Fort, near Lonavla in Maha
